recommendation: Keep this source fix. It preserves the approved non-performance scope guidance in the current status-based representation without changing Procedure status codes, bindings, cardinalities, or broader workflow alignment decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-11027 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and requested a Procedure.notPerformed usage note clarifying that a negated procedure did not occur as described, that code/body site/time information may scope the assertion, and that details such as performer or outcome are generally inappropriate because they imply narrower alternate circumstances.
initial_application: Commit 87f224c94cabbf01ee3789f815f26c69d05608d4 initially applied the issue by adding the requested comment and GF#11027 committee note to Procedure.notPerformed in the Procedure spreadsheet. Later FHIR-14063 workflow alignment removed Procedure.notDone/notPerformed as a separate boolean and represented non-performance with Procedure.status = not-done, but the detailed FHIR-11027 guidance did not carry forward.
additional_context: Procedure is an active current resource in source/fhir.ini. Current Procedure.status includes not-done, and Procedure.statusReason remains an exception-status reason element with an example binding. A 2017 Zulip implementers thread on negation in resources supports the distinction between broad never-had questions, which are usually Observation or QuestionnaireResponse, and Procedure.notDone/notPerformed for scheduled or ordered procedures not done. Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-11027 evidence.
reconciliation: Added GF#11027 to the current Procedure.status committee notes, restored not-done scope guidance to the Procedure.status comment, and updated the Procedure/Event mapping exception resource comment to match the authoritative Procedure source.
source_changes: source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml: added GF#11027 to Procedure.status committee notes and restored guidance for status not-done limiting other details to the activity type and scope of non-occurrence.
source/procedure/procedure-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: updated the Event mapping exception resource comment to mirror the revised Procedure.status comment.

related_jiras.note: Removed Procedure.notDone/notPerformed as a separate boolean and made Procedure.status = not-done the current representation, which explains where the FHIR-11027 guidance needed to move.
Confirmed Procedure.statusReason is for exception-status reasons with an example binding, supporting a status comment fix rather than a statusReason binding change.
Same 2016 Patient Care ballot family addressed negative Condition assertions and supports keeping broad never-had assertions outside Procedure.
